headline: In Shenzhen, China trains its robots to enter the labor market
summary: Engineers in Shenzhen are training Chinese robots so they can take on work in the labour market, beyond their known dance performances. The effort relies on artificial intelligence specialists.
why: Shenzhen is a major Chinese manufacturing and electronics hub. Commercial deployment of robots bears on automation costs and labour demand in manufacturing.
original_headline: En Shenzhen, China entrena a sus robots para incorporarlos al mercado laboral
